id.description: A content id, `mod:id`. Without a prefix it resolves to the Mod that writes it. ASCII only, so Go and JS sort ids the same way.

localId.description: An id local to one definition, such as a map's Planet ids. No namespace.

asset.description: An asset in a Mod's assets/ folder, written `__mod__/path`.

classStats.title: Class Stats
classStats.description: A Unit Class's default Battle stats.

richness.description: Per Resource id, how much a Planet's extractor buildings draw from it: none ×0, poor ×0.5, normal ×1, rich ×1.5. A Resource left out is none.

rarity.description: How likely a Tech is to be offered; rarer ones only above a Research rate.

botDifficulty.title: Bot Difficulty
botDifficulty.description: One level a Bot can play at. See docs/specs/bot-spec.md#difficulties.

id.description: Local to the Ruleset, e.g. easy.

noisePercent.description: The random ± spread on its goal scores.

attackMargin.description: How many times a target's estimated strength its Army needs before it attacks.

planDepth.description: How many steps its plans look ahead.

reservePercent.description: How much of each Stockpile cap it keeps back.

retreatBelowPercent.description: It Retreats from a Battle when its strength falls below this share of the enemy's; 0 never Retreats.

unitChoice.description: fixed: a set mix; advantage: by Advantage against the enemies seen.

research.description: first: the first card; goals: by its goals.

weights.description: Its goal weights, times its Faction's.

colour.description: What the client tints it with.

order.description: Where it's listed, lowest first; a tie goes by id.

botGoal.description: The Bot goal its Research serves; left out, the higher of the two.

researchMap.description: Research per second, keyed by Research field id.

from.description: The Research rate it's offered from.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: A Tech's modifier, by exactly one of `percent` or `amount`. `unitClass` or `unit` narrows a combat stat or buildTime; `resource` narrows extractorYield, upkeep or stockpileCap; `field` narrows research.

field.description: Narrows research to one Research field; left out, every field.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Units in one Stack, one entry per Unit Slot.

stacks.description: Up to a Planet's three Stacks, first Stack first.

combat.title: Combat
combat.description: Battle stats. A Unit Class missing from tiers counts as `normal`.

damage.description: The damage roll, in dice notation: NdM, or NdM+K.

speed.description: Cells per second; defaults from the Ruleset's battle.classDefaults.

range.description: Farthest it fires, in cells; defaults from battle.classDefaults.

minRange.description: Closest it fires, in cells (artillery). Defaults to 0.

fireInterval.description: Seconds between volleys; defaults from battle.classDefaults.

sight.description: Sight radius in cells; defaults from battle.classDefaults.

tiers.description: Per Unit Class id, how this attacker rolls against it: advantage rolls the to-hit and damage twice and keeps the higher, disadvantage keeps the lower, none can't target it.
